entities.summary: Ernst Boepple was a German schoolteacher and publisher who became a Nazi official and SS-Oberführer. He served as the deputy to Josef Bühler in occupied Poland during World War II and the Holocaust. After the end of the war, he was executed in Poland for war crimes.
